what: Structural survey of each cartridge's text, region by region. Labels are the survey's own structural claims; no mapping from a set of them to the name of a compiler exists, and none is asserted here.

discriminators.name: gp-relative-accesses
discriminators.counts: memory accesses and address formations based on $gp

discriminators.name: move-encoding
discriminators.counts: register-to-register copies, by the encoding chosen for them

discriminators.name: b-encoding
discriminators.counts: unconditional branches, by the encoding chosen for them

discriminators.name: stack-release-position
discriminators.counts: returns, by where the frame is released relative to `jr $ra`

discriminators.name: call-delay-slot
discriminators.counts: calls, by whether the delay slot was filled with work or left empty

discriminators.name: division-trap-pair
discriminators.counts: integer divisions, by whether a trap on a zero divisor follows

discriminators.name: double-operand-register-parity
discriminators.counts: double-format operands, by the parity of the float register they name

discriminators.name: double-transfer-form
discriminators.counts: double-width memory transfers, by whether one access or two carries the value

discriminators.name: float-argument-registers
discriminators.counts: float registers written in the four instructions before a call

code_not_surveyed.name: second_overlay_80400000
code_not_surveyed.why: the split configuration types it bin and fits it no vram, so there is no address at which to decode it; it is code and it is not surveyed
